data.name: Cupra windscreen replacement
data.description: Mobile Cupra windscreen replacement across Sydney and NSW. We confirm the exact glass your Cupra takes, arrange calibration where needed, and quote before.

mainEntity.name: Can you replace a Cupra windscreen at my home or work?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, and that is how we do most Cupra jobs. We bring the glass, the urethane and the tools to the vehicle. We need room to open both front doors and somewhere reasonably sheltered if it is raining.

mainEntity.name: Does my Cupra need the camera recalibrated after a new windscreen?

acceptedAnswer.text: Almost certainly, if it carries Front Assist. We confirm it from your build when you book and include it in the quote rather than adding it later. See windscreen replacement for how calibration fits into the job.

mainEntity.name: What decides the price of a Cupra windscreen?

acceptedAnswer.text: On a Cupra the single biggest step is whether Front Assist is fitted, because that adds a calibration to the job as well as narrowing the glass. The build year and grade decide the rest. Our cost guide explains each factor.

mainEntity.name: Can a chip in a Cupra windscreen be repaired instead?

acceptedAnswer.text: Often, and on a Cupra it is worth asking early: keeping the original glass means the camera behind it never moves, so there is no calibration to arrange either. See windscreen chip repair .
